snippet.title: The Real Mom Is the One Who Stayed
snippet.description:
A young mother vanished in the middle of the night, leaving her newborn baby behind with a poor elderly woman. With almost nothing to her name, the old woman worked day and night to raise the child with love, protection, and dignity.

Years later, the abandoned girl grew into a successful young woman—but when her biological mother suddenly returned, she discovered that giving birth doesn’t always make someone a real mom.

Sometimes, a real mother is simply the one who stays.

Watch until the end for this emotional story about sacrifice, loyalty, regret, and the true meaning of motherhood.

She didn’t give birth to her, but she gave her everything a mother should—love, sacrifice, protection, and a future.

Lyrics: 

*Verse 1:*
The white walls they scare me
The blank space on my knees
I stare at the ceiling
While trying to get you
To agree this feeling is dehumanizing
We're all wondering why
Everything is moving west
And the wind is blowing south

*Chorus 1:*
I'm picking petals with my teeth
Don’t know what I'm supposed to think about it
Trying anything I’ll consume the bottle from the rabbit
Never met him once but I’ll give him all my trust
When he says “follow me” to where my mom wouldn’t want me to be

*Verse 2:*
And I'm stuck on you but I can't stay here anymore.
I don't get you, but I get why you are the way you are.
And when I needed you, you thought best was to leave
But when you needed help I told you to call me
And baby you begged me to stay by your side
But when we're done fucking you're not satisfied
And you know you can't hunt with an unloaded gun
But you shoot and you fire and you hit more than once
Like a voice breaking glass, you break through my skin
Cause when you pull the trigger you know you won't miss

*Chorus 2:*
I’m picking petals with my teeth
Don’t know what I'm supposed to think about it
Trying anything I'll consume the bottle from the rabbit
Never met him once so give him all my trust
When he says “follow me” to where my mom wouldn’t want me to be

*Bridge:*
And it goes over again, over again
over again, over again
Oh it’s over again, over again
over again, over again
We go over again, over again
Over again, over again no

And I would burn feel you touching me
I’d burn to feel you more.
I don't want this I don't want you
This is nothing I prayed for
And the burn it turned to anger
And the anger turned to bleed
I'm forever a sinner while I tried to stay clean
You know that you like what you're doing to me
It makes you feel good but you're just so dirty

*Chorus 3:*
I’m picking petals with my teeth
Don’t know what I'm supposed to think about it
Trying anything I'll consume the bottle from the rabbit
Never met him once so give him all my trust
When he says “follow me” to where my mom wouldn’t want me to be
To where my mom wouldn’t want me to be
